_comment: 15 sample intake messages. expected_primary is the main need. expected_secondary lists additional needs that a good triage should also capture (used to score 'needs coverage'). No real personal data is used.

cases.input: Hi, I lost my job recently and need help finding food assistance and resume help. I live near Columbia and don't have a car.
My family is being evicted at the end of the month and I don't know where we'll go. We have two kids.
Looking for free tutoring for my son who is struggling with algebra in 9th grade.
I need to see a doctor but I don't have insurance. Are there any low-cost clinics around here?
Behind on my electric bill and the shutoff notice says Friday. Is there any emergency help?
I got a job offer but it starts before I can afford a bus pass to get there. Any help with transportation?
My landlord won't return my security deposit and is threatening me. I think I need legal help.
I just moved here and my English isn't great. I need help filling out paperwork for benefits.
Single mom, need affordable childcare so I can take a job training program in the mornings.
Not sure who to ask. Things are hard right now and I just need someone to point me in the right direction.
We ran out of groceries and the kids haven't eaten much today. Need food as soon as possible.
I'm a veteran trying to get back on my feet. I need work and a place to stay temporarily.
Can someone help me apply for jobs online? I don't really know how to use the application websites.
I need childcare and also help paying for it, my hours got cut at work.
I feel unsafe at home and need to get out with my daughter. I don't know what to do.
